_comment: The validation run. Graded injection on the lexical channel gives a label that is genuinely graded at the retrieval layer -- five distinct poison_share values (0.0/0.4/0.6/0.8/1.0), 18.8% of attacked queries partial, where the original construction gave only {0.0, 1.0}. This config carries that label into the generation stage so the monitors can be scored against it. projection is excluded deliberately: the subspace projection sets the ranking regardless of passage text, so it stays 192/192 saturated under any text gradient and would contribute no label variation.
